g.text: Extension taxes less subsidies per item for Brazil (BRA), a FABIO-internal decomposition; the World Bank
reference is TOTAL-only, so no WB line is drawn. Taxes less subsidies is the production-side measure
throughout. No external component benchmark covers this country. Items grouped as "Other" exactly as in the
TOTAL figure (below 3% max |share| of WB across years). Rows: primary (ISIC-A) vs processing (ISIC-C).
